dispatch_invariants: Snapshot candidate order and nested dispatch cursor at enumeration start; do not rebuild on restore from current memberships.
Candidate additions are excluded from current pass; fresh normal/late or early/ordinary passes can include them.
Type-specific Contains predicates, not generic active membership, control each saved candidate yield.
Removed powers retain Owner and may remain eligible in already captured dispatch; removal does not itself fail Power Contains.
Guarded combat dispatch evaluates ending once at enumeration entry; preserve setup exemption and direct-dispatch exceptions.
Modifier-contribution identity lists are not candidate snapshots; after-modification paths freshly enumerate and intersect eligible contributors.
safe_retirement_conditions: No active membership/owner retaining semantic state
No combat history or history-record graph references
Required captured descriptor and comparison data preserved
No altered allocator/generation/public instance identity behavior
native_vs_simulator: Native .NET strong references show required logical reachability, not a mandated reference-counting strategy or arena lifetime.
Native history references are mixed with explicit captured scalar values; preserve aliases and mutation semantics.
Run history SerializableCard/ModelId records are descriptors rather than direct CardModel references.
Retaining all native diagnostics is not automatically mandatory under bounded comparison contract; exclusions cannot remove future-affecting state.
exporter_limits: RecordingSession excludes MonsterPerformedMoveEntry, SummonedEntry, PotionUsedEntry by audited no-gameplay-consumer classification.
Synthetic path/label assignment is an exporter convention; it does not define native allocations or prove active zone membership.
regression_requirements: Same card/different play identity and matching started-finished aliases across suspension
Bolas previous-turn exact identity versus same-model duplicate
Juggling applied midturn and Normality/Ringing during a started-unfinished play
Removed captured power callback versus removed inventory/card callback predicates
New listener appears in fresh late pass only
Last-enemy lethal during guarded dispatch preserves remaining captured callbacks
AfterCombatEnd sees history and AfterCombatVictory sees cleared history
Live object mutation after log plus frozen WasEthereal/amount/turn fields
Nested room/run history and final scoring across acts
limits: No gameplay experiment or C++ behavior change.
Scoped consumer textual index cannot prove absence of delegated or reflective consumers.
No history compression or arbitrary capacity/early-retirement choice approved.
All external model/continuation references must be combined with sibling audit graphs before final retirement design.
